data.question: How to use refrigerator correctly?
How to use refrigerator in a healthier way?
How to use refrigerators to save energy?
What should the daily cleaning and sterilization of the refrigerator pay attention to?
Do I have to stop using the refrigerator when I go out?
What to watch out for if you want to stop using the refrigerator?
How to move the refrigerator properly?
data.answer: Before handling, take out the food in the refrigerator, fix the glass shelves and other fragile parts with adhesive tape, tighten the fixed supporting feet, hold the lower supporting feet and the rear handles of the refrigerator. When handling, the refrigerator should not be inverted or laid down. It can only be handled at a slight tilt of 45 degree. When the handling distance is long, the refrigerator should be placed on the vehicle upright.

data.question: Why does the refrigerator need to sit for a few hours before it can be powered up and running after being transported home?
data.answer:
1. There is lubricating oil in the bottom of the compressor. If the refrigerator is lifted upside down or tilted excessively during transportation, the lubricating oil will flow into the refrigeration system and affect the normal operation of the refrigeration system.
2. After the refrigerator is transported and placed steadily, let it stand for more than 4 hours and energize it, so that the lubricating oil that enters the refrigeration pipeline will flow back into the compressor and the refrigerant will be stabilized.

data.question: How to choose the refrigerator location?
data.answer:
1. The refrigerator should be placed on a flat place. If the refrigerator is not installed stably, it will cause vibration and noise.
2. Keep a proper distance from the surroundings. If the gap with the surroundings is too small, it will restrain the refrigerator from dissipating heat energy to the surroundings, causing the cooling capacity to decrease and the power consumption to increase.
3. The refrigerator shall not be installed in a humid place or where it is easily splashed with water. If installed in a humid environment, the refrigerator will become moldy, and the insulation performance will decrease and cause electric leakage.

data.question: When the refrigerator is uneven or shaking, how to adjust the bottom foot of the refrigerator correctly?
data.answer: The refrigerator that just bought often can appear put unsteady situation, appear this kind of circumstance needs to press and hold the opposite Angle of refrigerator top, vertical downward force, shake, check whether the front two support bottom foot clings to the ground; The rear two supports are wheels, no adjustment required. Turn the foot up clockwise and turn it down counterclockwise to make the front of the refrigerator slightly higher than the back. After adjustment, check again whether the refrigerator is placed smoothly.

data.question: Can you place sundries on the top of the fridge?
data.answer: It is recommended not to store sundries on the top of the refrigerator, the height of the refrigerator is generally higher, it is not convenient to take and put items; Secondly, when the refrigerator door is opened and closed, it will shake, which will easily make the top sundries fall off and threaten our safety. Finally, the top of the refrigerator is easy to accumulate dust, need to wipe frequently, not suitable to place sundries for a long time

data.question: How should do when the door body of freezer closes lax?
How to deal with excessive noise in refrigerator running process?
data.answer:
Explanation:
1. The refrigerator is noisy when it starts running, and it is unavoidable. Small refrigerators (<250L) with a noise level below 39 decibels and large refrigerators with a noise level below 42 decibels meet the standard.
2. Newly purchased refrigerator or refrigerator that has just stored more items needs to take away a large amount of heat from the refrigerator within 48 hours. The refrigerator has high operating power and loud sound, which is a normal phenomenon
3. If you find that the noise becomes louder after using it for a period of time, it is because the refrigerator has a slight shaking during operation, which makes the bottom feet of the refrigerator loose, and you should adjust the bottom feet for further observation.
Recommended methods:
1. Be sure to remove the bottom packaging foam. You need to adjust the bottom feet first during installation. Note that the first two feet should be adjusted slightly higher than the rear feet to reduce the sound made by the compressor when it is working. Make sure the refrigerator is placed directly on the flat ground, with all four feet on the ground and no one foot is suspended.
2. Avoid putting the refrigerator in the resting bedroom. The noise will be more obvious in small rooms or quiet nights. It is recommended to put it in the kitchen and other places that do not need to be too quiet.

data.question: Why does the refrigerator make an abnormal "click" sound when it starts and stops?
data.answer: If there is a sound when working and stopping, it is the sound made when the relay or solenoid valve (electric valve) is switched on.

data.question: Why does the inside of the refrigerator make a sound like "Bang-bang, boom"？
data.answer: The sound of "boom" inside the refrigerator is the sound produced by the thermal expansion and contraction of the heat insulation layer (foaming agent). Customers are advised to use it with confidence.(The liquid foaming fluid combines with air to form a solid, which will expand and contract with the change of ambient temperature)

data.question: Why does the inside of refrigerator make the sound of flowing water？
data.answer: The sound of running water is the sound of the refrigerant flowing in the refrigeration system and the sound of the refrigerator when it stops working, or the sound of the refrigerant evaporating in the evaporator. It is recommended that customers use it with confidence.

data.question: Why is there a slight "buzz" inside the refrigerator?
data.answer: The operation of the refrigerator compressor is a process of motor operation. It is normal that the constant internal operation will make a "buzz" sound during operation. The left, rear and right sides of the refrigerator should not be close to the wall to avoid echo;

data.question: Why is there a whirring of the wind inside the refrigerator?
data.answer: The air-cooled refrigerator equipped with a fan makes the air flow sound when the fan rotates, and the operation of the fan better realizes the uniform temperature in the refrigerator and the effect of food preservation.

data.question: Why does the refrigerator give out abnormal "di-di" alarm sound?
data.answer:
1. If the refrigerator door is not closed tightly, there will be an alarm to guide the user to close the door again;
2. Power on after 5 minutes of power failure.

data.question: Why is there an odor inside the refrigerator?
data.answer:
1. The unique plastic smell of some plastic parts when the new machine leaves the factory is a normal phenomenon. After a period of use, the smell will gradually disappear. It is recommended that customers open the refrigerator door for ventilation before use, or wipe the inside of the refrigerator with clean water before using.
2. Long-time users:
(a) Check whether the food in the refrigerator has been stored for too long beyond the expiration date, and whether it has gone bad and smelly.
(b) Check whether the inside of the refrigerator and the deodorizer have not been cleaned for a long time.
(c) Check whether food with strange smell is stored.

data.question: Ways to prevent odor inside the refrigerator?
Why is there an odor in the back of the refrigerator?
data.answer: The water on the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment is drained into the water collector behind the machine through the through-hole pin (drain hole) in the middle lower part of the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment. The water contains many impurities, which may give off a smell after evaporation. After the power is off, remove the backplate of the press and wipe clean the foreign matter in the bottom water collector.

data.question: Why is there an odor at the bottom of the refrigerator?
data.answer: If you find that there is an odor at the bottom of the refrigerator, it is recommended to move the refrigerator to check whether there is any foreign matter at the bottom, clean it, and use it further to observe whether the odor disappears.

data.question: Why doesn't the refrigerator work?
How to deal with the unsatisfactory refrigeration effect of refrigerator?
data.answer:
1. Adjust the set temperature of the refrigerator reasonably, try to increase the gear or lower the temperature.
2. Check whether the refrigerator door is not closed tightly; reduce the number of times of opening and closing the door, and try to shorten the opening and closing time.
3. Check whether there is too much stored food, which hinders the air circulation in the refrigerator and increases the heat load (it is recommended to use about 70% of the space in the refrigerator)
4. Do not put hot food in the refrigerator. It is recommended to wait until the food is completely cooled before putting it in the refrigerator.
5. The refrigerator should be placed in a place with good heat dissipation conditions, and check whether it is too tight against the wall.(It is recommended that the refrigerator be 5-10cm away from the wall)
6. Dirty, deformed and hardened door seals will cause poor sealing. It is recommended that users remove the door seal and wash it with warm water of about 60 degree (some detergent can be used appropriately), then after washing, drying and flattening it, use a hair dryer to evenly heat the door seal to restore its elasticity.
7. Whether the frost inside the refrigerator is very thick, perform regular defrosting.(Generally, manual defrosting is required if it exceeds 1cm)

data.question: The refrigerating room is not cooling?
data.answer:
1. Confirm whether the freezer is cooled. It may be that the ambient temperature is close to the temperature of the refrigerating room (the temperature of the refrigerating room ranges from 0°C to 10°C), and the user feels that it is not cooling subjectively;
2. The holiday mode of the computer refrigerating room is turned on, or the refrigerating room is closed, guiding the user to exit.

data.question: The freezer is not cooling?
Is it normal to have frost in the refrigerating room? How to deal with it?
data.answer:
Direct cooling refrigerator: The inner wall behind the refrigerator compartment is the position of the evaporator, which is in direct contact with the air inside the refrigerator. There is water vapor in the air, the temperature of the evaporator is very low and the water vapor forms a frost layer when it is cold, which is a normal phenomenon. When the compressor stops, the frost layer on the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment will slowly melt into water, which will be drained into the water collector behind the machine through the through-hole pins (drain holes) in the middle lower part of the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment, and will be evaporated when the compressor is working. No manual removal is required.(When the thickness of the frost on the rear wall reaches 1cm or more, manual defrosting is required)
The method to reduce frosting of direct cooling refrigerator:
1. If the food contains too much moisture, it is recommended to pack it in a fresh-keeping bag.
2. Food with high moisture should not be too close to the rear wall, which may cause icing (there is an evaporator on the rear wall of the direct cooling refrigerator and the temperature is lower)
3. Increase the temperature of the refrigerator compartment.
4. Frequent opening and closing of the refrigerator door or the door is not closed tightly can also cause icing/frosting in the refrigerator compartment.
Air-cooled refrigerator
1. Check whether the air outlet of the refrigerator compartment is blocked. If it is blocked, clean it before use.
2. Whether to select "smart" mode, guide exit.

data.question: Is it normal to have frost in the freezing room? How to deal with it?
Why is there dew on the outside of the refrigerator?
data.answer: Condensation will appear on the outside of the refrigerator when the environment is humid or rainy. This is caused by the moisture in the air contacting the surface of the refrigerator. Please feel free to use after wiping with soft cloth.

data.question: Why does the refrigerator not start after being connected to the power supply?
Is it normal for the refrigerator to compress and run continuously for a long time? How to deal with it?
data.answer:
Note: Under normal circumstances, the ratio of refrigerator work to downtime is about 1:0.55.
Explanation:
1. It takes a long time to run the newly purchased machine for the first time or after a long-term power outage. It is recommended to observe for 24 hours to confirm.
2. It is necessary to check whether the temperature setting is normal. For mechanical refrigerators, if the temperature control gear is set at a higher gear, it is normal that the refrigerator will not stop for a long time. It is recommended that customers select the gear in the middle gear for observation and use. In addition, if the low temperature compensation switch is not turned off, it will also cause the refrigerator to work for a long time. For electronically controlled refrigerators, if the temperature is set to the coldest or the quick-freezing function is enabled, there will be a long-term non-stop phenomenon. It is recommended that customers choose the appropriate temperature (about 5 degree) or wait for the quick-freezing function to stop before observing and using it.
3. Reasons of daily use:
(a) The stored food contains a lot of calories, and stored food is too much, with a large heat load.
(b) The door is open for many times, the door opening time is long and the door is not closed tightly, resulting in rapid cold and heat exchange between the outside and the inside of the refrigerator, which makes the temperature inside the refrigerator rise and increases the working time of the refrigerator.
(c) The ambient temperature is high or the distance between the refrigerator and the wall is too small (make sure the distance is at least 5-10cm), which delays the speed of heat dissipation, the condenser cannot release all the heat, and the heat re-enters the refrigerator to circulate, thus lengthening the working time of the refrigerator.
(d) The frost layer on the surface of the evaporator is too thick, hindering heat exchange and delaying the temperature from dropping to the set value, causing the compressor to remain working. Daily defrost should be done regularly to keep the frost layer thickness less than 5mm.
4. Other factors:
(a) When the refrigerator reaches the set temperature, it will enter a constant temperature state. At this time, the compressor stops working, and the refrigerator will work or stop working from time to time, which is a normal phenomenon.
(b) If the refrigerator itself is large (such as a side-by-side combination refrigerator), the operation time is relatively long.

data.question: Why does the refrigerator get hot in some places during operation?
data.answer:
1. It is normal for the refrigerator to become hot on both sides. For refrigerator heat dissipation, it is recommended to reserve 10-15cm space around the refrigerator. The temperature on both sides of the refrigerator that has just been powered on may reach about 70 degrees, and the temperature will decrease after a period of operation.
2. It is normal for the refrigerator door seal to become hot in the middle and around it. There are heating pipes around the door of the refrigerator, and the heating is placed around the door to produce condensation. General high-end refrigerators use this design.
3. It is normal for the internal position under the refrigerator to become hot. Part of the refrigerating room heating wire is attached to the inner position of the refrigerating room. When the temperature is low, the compensation heating wire works, and the bottom of the refrigerating room will feel hot when touched by hand.

data.question: How to adjust and set the temperature inside the refrigerator?
data.answer:
Mechanical refrigerator: adjust the gear position. The higher the gear position number, the lower the temperature. 0 gear means stop. 7 gear means no stop.
Computer refrigerator: There are many types of panels. It can be operated according to the product instruction.

data.question: Why is the set temperature different from the temperature shown on the display?
data.answer:
1. The display temperature indicates the current temperature in the refrigerator. Some users will test the temperature inside the refrigerator with a thermometer (± 2-3 degree deviation is a normal phenomenon). This is because the user is testing the temperature at a certain point in the refrigerator, rather than the temperature of the whole refrigerator.
2. The set temperature indicates the temperature we set to reach in the refrigerator.
3. When the temperature is set, the temperature in the refrigerator will gradually and slowly adjust to the temperature we set. During this process, the temperature on the display screen will gradually change to the set temperature.

data.question: What is the cause of electric leakage in refrigerator?
Does the main power switch trip frequently during the operation of the refrigerator?
data.answer:
1. Turn off other high-power appliances at home and only run the refrigerating room for test.
2. Use other electrical appliances to connect to the same power outlet. If it trips, contact a professional electrician to check the circuit.

data.question: How to use the low temperature compensation switch? What does it do?
data.answer: When the winter temperature is low, the ambient temperature is close to that of the refrigerator, which will result in the phenomenon that the refrigerator will not turn on and run or run for a short time, so that the freezing temperature of the refrigerator will not reach the set requirements, leading to the deterioration of food in the freezer. In order to avoid the above problems, a low temperature compensation switch is added in the design of the refrigerator. This switch is used to ensure that the refrigerator can work normally when the ambient temperature is low in winter. The use of low-temperature compensation switch is very simple. When the ambient temperature is lower than 16 degrees, the low-temperature compensation switch can be turned on. However, when the ambient temperature is higher than this temperature, the low-temperature compensation switch must be closed in time, otherwise the power consumption of the refrigerator will be increased.

data.question: What is the reason for the accumulation of water inside the refrigerator? How to deal with it?
data.answer:
Explanation:
When the compressor is working, the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment will be frosted or attached to ice beads. After the compressor stops working, the frost or ice beads on the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment will melt into water and drain into the water collector on the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment through the through-hole pin (drain hole) on the rear wall of the refrigerator compartment. If the through-hole pin (drain hole) is blocked, it will cause water accumulation in the lower part of the drawer of the refrigerator. At this time, measures need to be taken to clear the drain hole.
Treatment measures:
1. First, adjust the adjustable feet under the bottom of the refrigerator, so that the refrigerator is slightly tilted back about 5 degree.
2. The refrigerated shelf cannot be close to the inner wall, so that the accumulated water can drain along the inner wall.
3. Check whether the drain hole (the middle and lower part of the inner wall of the refrigerator compartment) is blocked (by ice and dirt).If it is blocked by ice, pour warm water from the drain hole to dredge; if it is blocked by dirt, use a thin iron wire to dredge.
4. After dredging, you can use about 100ml of warm salt water to introduce into the drain hole to clean the drain hole and confirm whether the drain hole is well cleared
5. Minimize the number of opening and closing the door and the time to open the door each time.

data.question: What is the cause of a small amount of leakage at the bottom of the refrigerator? How to deal with it?
data.answer:
1. Water leakage at the bottom. The water pan is overflowing. It is recommended to reduce the water content of the stored food or pack it with plastic wrap
2. The door body is dripping water, and the air humidity is high, resulting in condensation water.

data.question: How to deal with the deformation of door gasket?
data.answer: As with the increase in the number of times of opening and closing the door and the attachment of the door seal to the refrigerator for a long time, the door seal has been in a state of stress. After a long time, some aging and deformation will inevitably occur, causing partial depression and deformation, which leads to cold air overflow and then the refrigerator door cannot be closed tightly. It is recommended to remove the door seal and clean it, wipe it dry with a dry cloth, and flatten the door seal, and heat it evenly with a hair dryer to better restore its elasticity.

data.question: How to clean the door gasket after using for a long time?
data.answer: It can be cleaned regularly with general household cleaners, but special attention is that after cleaning, it must not be exposed to the sun, otherwise it will be deformed (it is recommended to wipe it with a dry cloth after cleaning, and flatten the door seal, and heat the door seal evenly with a hair dryer to restore the elasticity of the door seal)

data.question: Why is there water on the door gasket?
data.answer:
1. In damp or rainy weather, the environment has high humidity, and the cool air is easy to liquefy into dew and adhere around the door seal. You can observe and use after drying it.
2. At the same time, it is recommended to check whether the door seal is not tight and cause cool air leakage. It is recommended to use a hair dryer to blow the door seal evenly with hot air until it is soft and close the door for observation.

data.question: How to deal with insufficient adsorption capacity of door gasket strip?
data.answer: First check whether there is any dirt attached to the door seal. If there is, wipe it clean first, and then use a hair dryer to blow it around evenly with hot air; if there is still no suction after treatment, it is necessary to arrange on-site inspection by technicians.

data.question: How to deal with the sudden appearance of all kinds of warning codes on the refrigerator display?
data.answer: Different codes on the display screen represent different meanings. For example, code 8888 represents entering the mode of maintenance and detection. All codes can be found in the product instructions for the reasons and solutions.

data.question: Why should not stop using refrigerators in winter?
data.answer: The temperature is low during winter, even if the food is not in the refrigerator can also save for a long time. In order to save electricity, many users choose to stop using refrigerator. Actually, this kind of practice is dangerous, stop using the refrigerator will accelerate the bladder plastic aging speed and cause the pipeline corrosion or parts, reduce the service life of the refrigerator. So if there are no special circumstances, do not close the refrigerator even in the winter. Secondly, the energy consumption of refrigerators is relatively low. Moreover, the energy consumption of refrigerators in winter is only one third of that in summer, so users don't have to close their refrigerators in winter because they worry about consuming electricity.

data.question: What effect does child lock function have?
Refrigerator climate type division?
data.answer: The climatic types of the refrigerator are generally marked on the nameplate at the back of the refrigerator. The climatic types of the refrigerator can be divided into SN (sub-temperate zone, between 10 and 32 degrees), N (temperate zone, between 16 and 32 degrees), T (subtropical zone, between 18 and 38 degrees), and ST (subtropical zone, between 18 and 43 degrees). The climate type of refrigerator represents the environment and climate suitable for this model. TCL's products are all over the world. According to different climatic zones, refrigerators of corresponding climate models are specially designed to improve the service life and user experience of the products.

data.question: The refrigerator is recommended to be connected to a separate line?
data.answer: The refrigerator in the home should be wired separately, do not share one socket with other appliances, the refrigerator needs a stable voltage environment in the running process, the voltage fluctuation may lead to compressor can not start or burn out, reduce the service life of the refrigerator. In addition, the refrigerator had better not stop, separate wiring can also avoid stopping the refrigerator from running because of the total power trip in daily life.
